atten4.ptxt: For diagnosis screen transitions, refer to HDD Navigation System - Diagnosis System ().
For starting and exiting diagnosis, refer to HDD Navigation System - Diagnosis System ().

step3.ptxt: Start diagnosis and display the service check screen.
Select "Function Inspection/Adjustment" on the service inspection screen to display the function inspection/adjustment screen.
Select "Hands-free Volume Setting" on the function check/adjustment screen to display the hands-free volume setting screen.
Operate the screen switches to adjust the volume.

entry.ptxt: Adjusts the receiving volume (other party's voice heard by you) during hands-free calls
Transmitting volume (your voice heard by the other party) during hands-free calls - automatic adjustment

atten3.ptxt: If the receiving volume is changed more than necessary, the sound quality may deteriorate. Therefore, after changing the setting, check that there is no problem with the receiving sound quality.

item.ptxt: This screen is drawn by the navigation receiver assembly.
The transmitting volume is adjusted automatically and cannot be changed. The "Transmitting Volume" value can be changed, but manual changes are not reflected in the transmitting volume.
